resources.string: Herms
Herms fleet
Unavailable in this edition
This Play edition cannot read or operate other apps. Remote commands cannot enable this capability.
Background delivery
Android battery optimization stays enabled. Push (when configured) and periodic sync remain available; background delivery can be delayed.
On. Google wakes the phone; content comes straight from your gateway.
Not set up on your gateway.
Run progress
After you send a message or approve a step from this phone, %1$s stays connected while that run works and shows its progress in a notification. It stops when the run ends.
Without push

Notifications arrive while such a run is working and when you open %1$s. Android\'s periodic background check can also deliver them, often 15 minutes or more late. Set up push on your gateway for prompt notifications.
Run progress
Shown while a run works after you send a message or approve a step from this phone
Stop updates
Wake can\'t ring until you allow exact alarms. Local alarms are not scheduled, and alarms from your gateway can\'t start the alarm sound.
About AI replies
Replies come from the AI models and providers configured on your own %1$s gateway. %2$s does not run or choose them.
Replies can be wrong, outdated or inappropriate. Check anything important before you rely on it or let the agent act on it.
%1$s does not see your chats. They go between this phone, your gateway and the providers it uses.
To report a reply, long-press it and tap Report. For anything else, open Me, then Report a problem. Nothing is sent until you review the report and tap Send report.
Where replies come from, who sees your chats, how to report one
Got it
Installing APK attachments is unavailable in this Play edition. You can still save the file to Downloads.
Approvals, replies, cron & digests, run progress. Mute each one separately.
